scope: Local policy tranche for future stochastic qualification campaigns. The successor Q-023 profile registry and campaign drafts freeze every locally decidable seed, sampling, grid, fit-window, estimator, exclusion, tolerance, local-analyzer-candidate, and independent-recompute-plan field before qualifying output inspection. Clean-candidate bindings, missing qualifying decks and analyzers, Orion campaign roots, Frontier output, external reference extraction, later independent-recompute scripts, and reviewer dispositions remain explicitly open.

estimator_policy.fitted_quantity_rule: Archive per-seed fit inputs, fit window, fit diagnostics, and failed fits. Freeze the fit window before qualifying output inspection.

interval_policy.deterministic_oracle_rule: Use declared absolute and relative numerical tolerances instead of a stochastic interval.
interval_policy.reference_extraction_uncertainty_rule: Report digitization or extraction uncertainty separately and include it explicitly in the comparison model; never absorb it silently by broadening AthenaK tolerance.
interval_policy.small_sample_rule: If BCa assumptions or seed count are inadequate, mark the candidate limited or rerun_required and preregister a revised design before generating replacement qualifying data.

multiplicity_policy.secondary_endpoint_rule: Report as secondary or exploratory unless promoted through a preregistration revision before qualifying output inspection.
multiplicity_policy.sensitivity_scan_rule: Freeze which sensitivity endpoints are gates and which are descriptive before the qualifying run.

exclusion_policy.outlier_rule: Retain finite completed outliers in the qualifying estimate. Excluding one requires a linked finding with physical justification, external review, candidate-dataset invalidation, and a registered rerun.

independent_recompute_policy.implementation_rule: Critical metrics must be recomputed from archived raw artifacts by a reviewer-owned script or an independently implemented analyzer that does not import production metric-extraction functions.

reproducibility_levels.bitwise_reproducibility: Use only where execution ordering and backend make bitwise identity a declared requirement.
reproducibility_levels.deterministic_metric_reproducibility: Require declared numerical tolerance for deterministic metric comparisons.
reproducibility_levels.statistical_agreement: Require preregistered aggregate estimator, interval, and multiplicity policy for stochastic comparisons.

open_items: Materialize one immutable expanded campaign record from the locally frozen profiles before each qualifying run.
Create and checksum the missing qualifying decks and production analyzers identified by each campaign draft.
Freeze exact fiducials, saturation windows, external-reference maps, extracted values, and remaining numeric tolerances where the draft records an explicit dependency.
Freeze the clean candidate commit, Frontier executable checksum, input and production-analysis checksums, Orion campaign artifact root, and CPU/MPI/GPU assignment before qualifying output inspection.

Implement or archive the reviewer-owned or independently implemented critical-metric recomputation script, recompute from archived raw artifacts, and obtain external reviewer disposition before claim closure.
